mapper.insert: insert into tb_second_hand_order( id, order_number, product_id, bargain_id, buyer_id, seller_id, product_amount, pay_amount, service_fee_rate, service_fee, seller_income, delivery_mode, pickup_address_snapshot, buyer_delivery_address_id, buyer_delivery_address_snapshot, delivery_remark, status, pay_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, delivered_time, confirm_deadline, finish_time, transfer_time, transfer_fail_reason, deleted, create_time, update_time ) values( null, #{orderNumber}, #{productId}, #{bargainId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{serviceFeeRate}, #{serviceFee}, #{sellerIncome}, #{deliveryMode}, #{pickupAddressSnapshot}, #{buyerDeliveryAddressId}, #{buyerDeliveryAddressSnapshot}, #{deliveryRemark}, #{status}, #{payTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelReason}, #{deliveredTime}, #{confirmDeadline}, #{finishTime}, #{transferTime}, #{transferFailReason}, #{deleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select * from tb_second_hand_order where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select * from tb_second_hand_order where order_number = #{orderNumber} and deleted = 0
select * from tb_second_hand_order where product_id = #{productId} and deleted = 0 and status in (0, 1, 2, 5, 8) order by create_time desc limit 1
mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_number, o.product_id, o.bargain_id, o.buyer_id, buyer.username as buyer_name, o.seller_id, seller.username as seller_name, p.title as product_title, o.product_amount, o.pay_amount, o.service_fee_rate, o.service_fee, o.seller_income, o.delivery_mode, o.pickup_address_snapshot, o.buyer_delivery_address_id, o.buyer_delivery_address_snapshot, o.delivery_remark, o.status, o.pay_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_reason, o.delivered_time, o.confirm_deadline, o.finish_time, o.transfer_time, o.transfer_fail_reason, o.create_time, o.update_time
mapper.select: select from tb_second_hand_order o left join tb_second_hand_product p on o.product_id = p.id left join tb_user buyer on o.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on o.seller_id = seller.id where o.id = #{id} and o.deleted = 0

select from tb_second_hand_order o left join tb_second_hand_product p on o.product_id = p.id left join tb_user buyer on o.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on o.seller_id = seller.id where o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} and o.deleted = 0 order by o.create_time desc

select from tb_second_hand_order o left join tb_second_hand_product p on o.product_id = p.id left join tb_user buyer on o.buyer_id = buyer.id left join tb_user seller on o.seller_id = seller.id where o.seller_id = #{sellerId} and o.deleted = 0 order by o.create_time desc
select * from tb_second_hand_order where deleted = 0 and status = 0 and create_time < #{time}
select * from tb_second_hand_order where deleted = 0 and status = 2 and confirm_deadline <= #{now}
